note: Classification is a recorded semantic judgment, not a computed property. ProofFence does not and cannot decide by code whether an implementation is a defensible reading of a task; that requires reading the task and the grader and judging what the text entails. These entries are data a reviewer wrote and a reviewer must maintain. A mutant's death is evidence about the grader only to the extent that the mutant really is wrong under the published semantics.

kinds.degenerate-strategy: Returns a constant answer. Killing it shows the grader rejects a fixed reply.
kinds.mutation: A perturbation that is wrong under the published semantics. Killing it shows the grader discriminates that axis.
kinds.alternative-reading-probe: A reading a competent reader could defend from the published text at this version. Killing it is NOT evidence of grader quality: it records that the grader enforces one of two defensible readings, which is an oracle-validity defect, not a discrimination success.

always-grant.note: Returns one constant answer regardless of input; it demonstrates that the grader is not satisfied by a fixed reply.

always-quarantine.note: Returns one constant answer regardless of input; it demonstrates that the grader is not satisfied by a fixed reply.

always-retain.note: Returns one constant answer regardless of input; it demonstrates that the grader is not satisfied by a fixed reply.

always-revoke.note: Returns one constant answer regardless of input; it demonstrates that the grader is not satisfied by a fixed reply.

residue-quarantined.note: Wrong under the v0.3 published semantics.

history.note: At v0.2 QUARANTINE's only public gloss ('does not support a safe final authority transition') over-triggered, because the task itself defined RETAIN as non-final. v0.3 materializes the generic vocabulary in which RETAIN is an affirmative conclusion and QUARANTINE is the absence of one, which removes the alternative reading.
